answer: Every new identity enters through one shared trellis, where the k-th clone on a funding river pays k^1.5 credits, burnt on arrival: a farm minting 500 clones spends about 2.2 million credits while an honest newcomer pays 1. Splitting funds across trails never resets the curve because trails cluster into a single nebula by shared payment fingerprints, and burnt fees are permanent, non-refundable, non-transferable. It fails when farms launder funding through mixers, so per-epoch registrations stay capped to keep every fingerprint inspectable.
